title: Marketing Campaign Executive
description:
Marketing Campaign Executive

Harrogate, GH1

Salary: £30,000-£32,000 per annum + Benefits

Full Time, 40 hours per week

Role summary

An exciting opportunity to plan, deliver and optimise integrated brand and in-house marketing campaigns across email, social media, web, paid channels and in-store POS and event activity. Working with marketing, e-commerce, buying teams and external agencies and brand partners, you will coordinate content, assets and schedules to deliver launches on time and within budget.

This role suits a hands-on marketer with experience across the marketing mix, strong design and planning skills, attention to detail and a data-led approach.

Key responsibilities
- Own brand and in-house campaign delivery with marketing, e-commerce and buying teams, from brief and audience targeting to digital and offline launch and review.
- Manage campaign calendars, assets, deadlines and approvals with internal teams, agencies and brand partners.
- Write, design and proofread on-brand campaign content; coordinate creative briefs and asset production. Including email, social post, product launch assets.
- Build and schedule Klayvio emails, select audience segments and check content, links and tracking.
- Work with the agency or e-commerce lead to ensure website products and assets are accurate and ready for launch.
- Support paid and organic social activity, testing messaging, creative and audiences.
- Track budgets, costs and campaign performance; report results and use customer insights and competitor observations to improve future campaigns.

Experience and skills

Essential
- 2+ years hands-on experience in a marketing executive, campaign coordinator or similar role, with campaign examples.
- Experience delivering email, social media and website activity and coordinating agencies or external suppliers.
- Design skills using Adobe, Canva or similar to create house-style assets.
- Strong copywriting, proofreading and communication skills, adapting messaging for different audiences.
- Practical experience with Microsoft Office, email platforms, content management systems and reporting tools.
- Confidence analysing data and using spreadsheets to report campaign activity and metrics to brand partners.
- Strong organisation, attention to detail and deadline management skills, with a proactive, collaborative approach to colleagues, agencies and brand suppliers.

Desirable
- Klayvio and Shopify experience.
- Paid search or social campaign experience.
- Familiarity with audience segmentation and marketing automation.
- Creative briefing experience.
- A customer-centric approach and retail interest or experience.
- A relevant marketing qualification or at least two years equivalent practical experience.
- Driving license.

What success looks like in this role
- Accurate, on-brand campaigns delivered on time and within budget, supported by productive agency relationships.
- Consistent inventory calendar planning, to outline launch dates and work to achieve successful product go live.
- Clear launch reporting against agreed engagement, traffic, enquiry, conversion and return-on-spend measures.
- Campaign learnings applied to improve future activity.

Salary and package.
- £32,000 per annum.
- Full-time role 40 hours per week
- 20 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Extra day off for your Birthday.
- Generous staff discount on product.
- Complimentary race places from our race partners.
- Brand immersion days.
- Brand products.
- Staff incentives.
- Employee assistance programme.
- Office based role.

INDLS

You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.
